'''FK Radnički Nova Pazova''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Раднички Нова Пазова}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Nova Pazova]], [[Vojvodina]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[Vojvodina League South]], the fourth tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]."}}
